name: xi.electron
description: Electron desktop shell for Sovlium. Reuses apps/xi.web as the renderer.
author: xi.effect

scripts.build: node scripts/ensure-web-bundle.mjs && node scripts/build-main.mjs && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.build:macos: node scripts/ensure-web-bundle.mjs && node scripts/build-main.mjs && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.build:windows: node scripts/ensure-web-bundle.mjs && node scripts/build-main.mjs && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
